From the Patio I
O'Keeffe and Texas, 1998, McNay Art Museum (San Antonio)

description: Yellowish brown support beams hold up a brown adobe patio. The patio extends from the white walls of a house, which features a window and screen door. Wooden support beams known as vigas protrude from the house's roof. A chimney emerging from the roof extends upward into a band of bright blue sky overhead.
title: The Patio – No. I
